stones: High bastions rising in terraced masonry
Roofs covered in oxidized zinc scales
Span 1: Height of lamppost <-> distance from ground of a hanged usurper's swaying feet
Span 2: Line strung from lamppost to opposite railing <-> festoons of the queen's nuptial procession
Span 3: Height of that railing <-> leap of the adulterer who climbed over it at dawn
Span 4: Tilt of guttering <-> a cat's slip into the same window
Span 5: Firing range of a gunboat suddenly appearing beyond the cape <-> bomb that destroyed the guttering

Span 6: Rips in the fish net <-> three old men seated on the dock mending nets, telling for the 100th time the story of the gunboat of the usurper, said to be the queen's illegitimate son abandoned in swaddling clothes on the dock
Street corners, window gratings, step banisters, lightning rod antennae, flagpoles marked with scratches, indentations, scrolls like the lines of a hand
calvino_source.inner_architecture: Static spatial measurements tell NOTHING; Zaira consists solely of causal relationships between the measurements of its space and the events of its past, soaking up memories like an expanding sponge without ever speaking its past aloud.
calvino_source.primary_risk: Exposing historical prose or tooltips during static browsing or single-object inspection. Inspecting any individual landmark or reading static geometry must remain strictly mute; memory surfaces ONLY across two-point relational caliper spans.

anti_trude_vector.medium: Palimpsest chiromancy & brass surveyor's proportional caliper etching over expanding sponge-bastions, accompanied by 16th-century copperplate cartography (map.png / map.svg) and fine-art architectural plate (image.png)
anti_trude_vector.interaction_law: Two-point caliper spanning across 9 mute architectural anchors (A1..A9). Single-point hover/click yields cold, silent architectural metrics ('tells nothing'). Locking any of the 6 canonical two-point spans physically swells the bastion stonework via radial/capsule sponge-deformation fields and engraves palm-line scratches, indentations, and calligraphic scrolls across the masonry.
anti_trude_vector.dom_signature_strategy: Bespoke custom HTML5 elements (<zaira-palimpsest>, <bastion-elevation>, <caliper-vernier-bar>, <sponge-saturation-meter>, <chord-selector-strip>, <chiromancy-scroll-tray>, <scar-etching-entry>, <datum-vernier-readout>, <zaira-plate-drawer>) and exclusively zaira-prefixed CSS selectors to guarantee Jaccard DOM/CSS similarity J_dom < 0.35 against all other Atlas cities.

zaira-surveyor.epistemic_boundary: Knows ONLY mute high-bastion architecture, oxidized zinc-scale roofs, stair-streets, curved arcades, window gratings, lightning rods, flagpoles, the 9 anchor coordinates (A1..A9), sponge-deformation vertex hooks, and procedural palm-line scratch/indentation/scroll ink stroke renderers. Must contain ZERO historical lore strings.

zaira-scar-etcher.epistemic_boundary: Owns the interactive 2-point brass caliper physics, vernier geometry, radial/capsule sponge-expansion field deformPoint(x,y), and the 6 canonical spatial-to-historical relational spans forming the closed usurper/queen/adulterer/cat/gunboat/dock-elders causal chain. Never emits lore unless a canonical 2-point span is actively measured.

zaira-sponge-weaver.epistemic_boundary: Bundles layers/mute_bastions.js and layers/relational_scars.js into standalone index.html with inspectable Map & City Plate drawer/tab (src='map.png' and src='image.png'), supporting 1280x800 desktop and 390x844 mobile viewports, mouse/touch/keyboard calipers, WebAudio acoustics, prefers-reduced-motion, and strict HG-1 zero unmeasured spoilers.

zaira-critic.epistemic_boundary: Read-only verifier auditing HG-1..HG-5 strictly across index.html, map.svg, map.png, and image.png.

frozen_gates.HG-1_MUTE_STATIC_STONE: Initial page load, static browsing (including inspecting the Map & City Plate drawer at 0/6 spans), and single-anchor hover/click must expose ZERO historical lore (no usurper, queen, nuptial, adulterer, cat, gunboat, bomb, swaddling in initial visible/rendered DOM or in layers/mute_bastions.js). Memory surfaces ONLY across measured 2-point caliper spans.
frozen_gates.HG-2_SIX_RELATIONAL_SPANS_AND_SPONGE: All 6 canonical spatial spans unlock via order-independent 2-point brass caliper measurement (pointer drag, 2-tap, and keyboard), physically expanding the sponge-city vertex geometry via deformPoint(x,y), engraving palm-line scratches/indentations/scrolls, and linking into the closed 6-part genealogical causal loop.
frozen_gates.HG-3_STANDALONE_RESPONSIVE_ACCESSIBLE: Self-contained index.html with zero external HTTP/CDN links and zero ../ cross-city imports; inspectable Map & City Plate drawer displaying local map.png and image.png; clean layout at 1280x800 and 390x844; full mouse, touch, and keyboard caliper support; prefers-reduced-motion honored.
frozen_gates.HG-4_ANTI_TRUDE_MORPHOLOGY: Bespoke custom element hierarchy and zaira-scoped CSS selectors maintaining Jaccard similarity J_dom < 0.35 against all Atlas cities.
frozen_gates.HG-5_CARTOGRAPHIC_AND_ILLUMINATED_PLATES: Valid, non-empty bespoke map.svg (1600x1200), map.png (1600x1200, valid PNG, high pixel/color variance), and image.png (1600x1000, valid PNG, rich variance) present in cities/04_zaira/.
